cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama Senate for District 20 since 2006. Earlier served in the Alabama House (District 60) and on the Birmingham City Council. Her work background includes marketing, real estate, teaching and compliance administration. Born in Birmingham; holds degrees from Alabama A&M and UAB.

endorsements.text: Listed by Ballotpedia as endorsed by People First (Sway voting group by Judy) for 2026.

cands.gaps: We found no campaign website statements, interviews or questionnaire answers from her. She did not complete Ballotpedia's 2026 Candidate Connection survey, so her stated positions on data centers, property taxes, land buying, growth, immigration, guns, school choice and policing are unknown. Ballotpedia's list of bills she sponsored was empty on the page we read, so we could not document sponsored bills on those topics. Her abortion votes come from a Wikipedia summary rather than a legislative record, and it does not name the bill or date. We found nothing on her family background beyond birthplace and high school, and no controversies or foreign ties.
